title: Give a mixin an input
summary: A mixin can take an input value. A default value is used when the caller does not provide one.
introduction: A mixin can take an input value. A default value is used when the caller does not provide one. Your task: Give the game frame an orange border.

Use Dart Sass on your computer. Install Node.js first, with help if needed. Save SCSS examples as lesson.scss and run npx sass lesson.scss lesson.css. This site does not compile Sass.

blocks.title: Give a mixin an input

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `@include` inserts the named mixin's style declarations into the current selector rule.
`@mixin` defines a reusable group of style declarations. Parameters in parentheses let each call choose a value.

blocks.text: The book border is navy. The game border is green because its call supplies a different input.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Put the input inside parentheses. A class named green is not the same thing as a colour value.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Give the game frame an orange border.
